description: OpenAI-compatible chat completions on DeepSeek R1 Distill (Qwen 32B), chain-of-thought reasoning model. Set your OpenAI SDK base URL to https://agents.citiviewgroup.com/v1/r1 and pay per token with x402 instead of an API key: $0.994 per million input and $9.762 per million output tokens, minimum $0.002 a call, at most $0.1104. The 402 quotes your request's maximum; "upto" payers are charged only the tokens used. Same request/response shape as OpenAI (reasoning, streaming supported), up to 8192 output tokens. Costs $0.1104 USDC per call (x402).
